title: The Two Trees and the Threefold Triad
description: The foundational structures the seeker meets first. T2 maps life and death as two trees with corresponding members: one rational faculty in five degrees ascending toward the Lord, and the same five turned the other way — reflection as the law of death, counsel as exchange and furnace, teaching as smoke-filled gehenna, thought as stronghold, mind as the gathered clod. T3 names the threefold principle (blessedness, wisdom, power) at three registers — outermost worldly, ordering interior, inmost divine — establishing the patterned triad through which everything else in the seeking will be mapped.
